beats.say: Lauren Hemp is now just three assists away from the WSL record.
According to The Guardian, the 26-year-old set up two goals in Sunday's 3-2 win against Brighton.
Both assists arrived inside sixteen minutes, setting up Khadija Shaw to hit career numbers 50 and 51.
The Guardian notes Hemp already has eight goal contributions this season.
Only record holder Beth Mead sits ahead on 54 WSL assists.
Can Lauren Hemp beat Beth Mead's all-time record this season?

facts: Lauren Hemp set up two goals in Sunday's 3-2 win against Brighton to close in on the WSL all time assist record.
The 26 year old recorded assists numbers 50 and 51 within the opening 16 minutes of the game by setting up Khadija Shaw twice.
Lauren Hemp now sits just three assists behind record holder and teammate Beth Mead, who has 54 in total.
Lauren Hemp has eight goal contributions for the season.
